Roxy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Clocking Out Myth</color>.

ActivityBattleStylish_032_SkillContext:
<color=#FFAF2C>In-game Scoring System:</color>
Click the Technique Details button to view technique tutorials
· Trigger Perfect Dodge: Score <color=#2BAD00>+60</color>
· Launch Chain Attack: Score <color=#2BAD00>+60</color>
· Launch Ultimate: Score <color=#2BAD00>+120</color>
· Apply Gash: Score <color=#2BAD00>+60</color>
· Activate Maim: Score <color=#2BAD00>+90</color>
· Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging Third Hit: Score <color=#2BAD00>+60</color>
ActivityBattleStylish_032_SkillContext1: While in the <color=#FFAF2C>Crimson Inscription</color> state, after the repeatedly pressing or holding is stopped during the 3rd hit of <color=#FFAF2C>Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging</color>, Claret leaps up and slams down, during which <color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Dodge</color> can be triggered. Upon successful trigger of <color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Dodge</color>, the 3rd hit of <color=#FFAF2C>Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging</color> can be chained again.
ActivityBattleStylish_032_SkillContext2: When there are at least 2 characters in your squad, you can launch a <color=#FFAF2C>Chain Attack</color> after hitting a Stunned enemy with a <color=#FFAF2C>heavy attack</color>.
ActivityBattleStylish_032_SkillContext3: Once your Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFAF2C>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to launch an <color=#FFAF2C>Ultimate</color>.
ActivityBattleStylish_032_SkillContext4: When Claret's attacks hit enemies, they accumulate <color=#FFAF2C>Gash</color> on the target.
ActivityBattleStylish_032_SkillContext5: While in the <color=#FFAF2C>Crimson Inscription</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to use <color=#FFAF2C>Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron</color>, consuming 1 stack of <color=#FFAF2C>Gash</color> and triggering <color=#FFAF2C>Maim</color>; hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to use <color=#FFAF2C>Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault</color>, consuming up to 3 stacks of <color=#FFAF2C>Gash</color> and triggering <color=#FFAF2C>Maim</color>.
ActivityBattleStylish_032_SkillContext6: While in <color=#FFAF2C>Crimson Inscription</color> state, when the 3rd hit of <color=#FFAF2C>Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging</color> is activated, repeatedly press or hold to extend the duration of continuous Slashes. Once the input stops, Claret leaps up and slams down, during which a <color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Dodge</color> can be triggered. Upon successful activation, you can chain into the 3rd hit of <color=#FFAF2C>Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging</color> again.

ActivityDetail_Digiboo_OB3.2:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Requirements]</color> 
Reach Inter-Knot Lv. <color=#D9A600>20</color> and complete the main story <color=#D9A600>Chapter 1 - Intermission</color> to participate.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Event Details]</color> 
• During the event, the Proxy will receive a game console called "Orbie-volution." Embark on your exclusive Orbie growth journey!
• Proxies can obtain <color=#D9A600>2</color> Grub by logging in daily, and <color=#D9A600>1</color> Grub by consuming <color=#D9A600>30</color> Battery Charge per day, for a total of <color=#D9A600>3</color> Grub per day.
• Complete limited-time reward missions during the event to obtain <color=#D9A600>Polychromes</color>, the <color=#D9A600>title "The Chosen Caretaker"</color>, and various <color=#D9A600>upgrade materials</color>.
※ Fully evolved pets will carry over to subsequent events in the series. Pets that have not been fully raised during the event will not retain their upgrade progress.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Gameplay Details]</color>
• During the event, Proxies can hatch a pet egg to obtain a pet Orbie. Feeding them Grub provides EXP needed for them to level up and attributes needed for evolution. When the mood value drops too low, they will be unwilling to eat, and you'll need to pet them or clean up foreign matter to restore its mood.
• Orbie's growth is divided into multiple stages: Levels 1–9: "Hatchling Stage," levels 10–19: "Budding Stage," levels 20–29: "Mature Stage," and level 30: "Final Form."
• Evolution attributes are divided into <color=#D9A600>Hyperfocus</color> and <color=#D9A600>Endurance</color>, each corresponding to a distinct final form. When the pet reaches Lv. 30, it will evolve into the corresponding fully evolved form based on the <color=#D9A600>highest</color> attribute value. If both attributes are equal, it will randomly evolve into one of the two final forms. For detailed evolution info, please check the database.
• It takes approximately <color=#D9A600>4 days</color> to fully raise one pet to full evolution — plan your time accordingly, Proxies.
• Once a pet reaches full evolution, Proxies will receive a new pet egg, which can be hatched after <color=#D9A600>04:00 (server time)</color> the following day.
• When Proxies log in during the event or have been online for 5 minutes, they can receive <color=#D9A600>1</color> Gift from their pet, for a maximum of 2 Gifts per day. Obtaining gifts unlocks corresponding database entries. Some gifts can only be obtained from <color=#D9A600>fully evolved pets</color>. For more details, please check the database.

ActivityPinball_MainPageTip_Desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Introduction]</color>
· In this desolate world, the Pinball Knights cross paths at the intersection of fate, chasing the true essence of beauty!
· Once the event kicks off, Proxies can head to Gear Street to help Kahkiboo, the manager of Chic Bootique, fine-tune the pinball machine, collect inspiration for pinballs, and test out stages.
Note: This game is still in beta. All final interpretations are reserved by the manager of Chic Bootique.
· Reach Inter-Knot Lv. <color=#FFAF2C>20</color> and complete the main story <color=#FFAF2C>Chapter 1 - Intermission</color> to participate.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Kahkiboo's Special Gift]</color>
· Complete limited-time reward missions during the event to earn event-exclusive <color=#FFAF2C>accessory rewards</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>Hamster Cage Pass</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>Polychromes</color>, and various upgrade material rewards.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Pinball Knight - Mission Mode]</color>
· During the event, event story and Mission Mode gameplay will <color=#FFAF2C>unlock gradually over time</color>.
· In this mode, Proxies must choose the right pinballs and defeat enemies to claim victory in each stage.
· As the event progresses, more pinballs and stages will be unlocked.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Pinball Knight - Challenge Mode]</color>
· As event missions progress, Challenge Mode will be unlocked.
· In this mode, Proxies will take on a Time Trial Challenge, aiming to eliminate as many enemies as possible to rack up points.

· If you fail to protect the base within the time limit, the challenge will be considered a failure!

Activity_Chat_ActivityDetectiveV2_311260: Ehn-ne, ehn-ne. (Guess I dragged my feet too long and he couldn't wait, so he bounced. We kept in touch for a bit. He was still texting back yesterday, but today... Complete radio silence...)
Ehn-ne, ehn-ne? (B—But... why didn't you reply to my messages?)
Never hurts to keep things on a strictly need-to-know basis... It means I can't spill all the mission details to you guys yet...
Another sweep of the area uncovers absolutely nothing. Hitting a dead end, the crew has no choice but to fall back to the detective agency and sifts through the intel they already have.
Naturally, since it's a case about smuggling Carrots, the CCD would be involved...

Oh? If it isn't the Temporary Detective Assistant. Hobble's still stuck clearing out my backlog from when I skipped work today. Once we're done at the CCD, it's straight back to the office to sort through the commission logs.

My bad! Trustie... I mean, this Security Guardboo's cache is dealing with a bit of an overload, so I'm still working on clearing it out for him. Problem is, the tech department's wiring is acting up, so I haven't been able to get a read on the cache at all.
After some quick tinkering, the Security Guardboo is successfully restored to normal...
Hold tight for a sec. I'll have Trustie, that's this Security Guardboo right here, run your IDs. Sorry for the holdup...
The Security Guardboo makes quick work of the ID and security checks, ushering everyone into the CCD office...
Ehn-nha? (Huh? You're back already? Oh, and the weirdest thing happened to me today. On my way back to the detective agency, I heard a Bangboo crying out for help from a nearby alley!)
Wuh-ne! (And the tailoring chip I've been waiting forever for. Now I can officially join the Chic Bootique!)
Wuh-ne, wuh-ne-ne.(Yeah, I was just following Fugui's orders...)
Wuh-ne, wuh-ne-ne. (Long story short, I'm really sorry! I got used to bullying folks and throwing our weight around with Chandler... even had the nerve to think about jumping you guys...)
Wuh-ne-ne... (Not at all. I was just putting on a tough act. Everything you did was for the investigation, I totally get it...)
Wuh-ne, wuh-ne-ne. (So, we were wondering if you two could hand over the remaining Profession Chips for us to deliver... We'd also like to personally apologize to all the Bangboo who got scammed.)
Activity_Chat_ActivityDigibooV3_2_301601: Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne! (So your company also makes game consoles!)
Ehn, ehn-ne, nu-ne-ne. (Of course. The wildly popular Orbie-volution, now a sensation across Booastrum, is one of our company's products. Its reputation rings just as loudly as its name.)
Ne! Ehn... (Wow! That sounds amazing...)
...Ehn-ne-ne. Ehn-ne? (...If you're interested, I happen to have one with me. Would you like to give it a try?)
Ehn? Ehn-ne... (Huh? Thank you, but I don't have any Dennies...)
Ehn-ne, nu-ne, ehn-ehn. (Dennies? Oh... Don't get me wrong. I'm not the kind of Bangboo who sees every friend as a potential customer.)
Ehn-ne-ne-ne, ehn... (All I need is... well, if you could introduce this game console to your Master, that would be wonderful...)
...Wait!
Don't trick my Bangboo!
Ehn-ehn. (Ah, it's you, miss.)
Ehn-ne. Ehn-ne-ne. (Please don't take it the wrong way. I have only the deepest respect for you and your Bangboo.)
Ehn-ehn-ne-ne—ehn-ne-ne... (As a token of my respect, I have prepared a gift for you—this very game console. On behalf of my company, I would be honored to present it to you...)
Batteries don't come out of thin air!
What's it gonna cost me?
...Ehn-ne. (...That's nothing worth mentioning.)

Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne, ehn-ne. (All we ask is that you grant our company permission to use "the game console beloved by a distinguished guest of the External Strategy Department" as our promotional slogan. That's all.)
Ne-ehn-ehn? (You see, this is truly a win-win deal, isn't it?)
Darn it... I'm kind of tempted.
Tricking Eous into this is a bit much, you know.
Ehn-ne-ne—ne-ne! (As the saying goes—once your heart is moved, take action! Just give the nod, and this game console is yours!)
Ne... Ehn-ne? (So... do we have a deal?)

This Bangboo politely reaches out its arm, even stretching up on tiptoe in an attempt to shake your hand...
...What a hardworking little Bangboo!
Alright! You decide to agree for now. It's only for Eous... not because you're interested yourself or anything!
Let's go with that.
I'll take the console!
Ehn-ne, ehn, ehn-ne. (Then... it's a deal. The game console goes to you and Eous, and the promotional slogan goes to me. It's settled.)
Ehn-ne-ehn. (It's getting late. Time for me to call it a day. See you two around.)
Ehn-ne, ne-ehn-ehn. (It's a win-win strategy, dear miss. You get to play, I get a little less work, and everyone is happy!)
Ehn-ne, ne-ehn-ehn. (It's a win-win strategy, dear sir. You get to play, I get a little less work, and everyone is happy!)
Ehn-ehn. (Ah, it's you, sir.)
Eous
Cody
Ehn-ne, ehn-ne. (We meet again, dear miss.)
Huh? Cody?
Oh? That hardworking Bangboo!
Ehn, ehn-ne-ne. (That's me. I'm glad you still remember me.)
Ehn-ne-ne-ne. (I'm here to share some wonderful news. Ever since you became the face of Orbie-volution, our sales have skyrocketed.)
Ehn, nu-ne, ehn-ne... (My boss is very pleased with my performance. I received an extra bonus, and I've even been promised a raise at the end of the year...)
...Ehn-ne-ne. (...And none of this would have been possible without you.)
You didn't actually do much...
...Except for tricking my Bangboo!
Ehn-ne-ne-ne. (Once I completed the most important step, choosing the right sales strategy, my work was already done.)
Ehn, ne-na. (Of course. As a good partner, I always value long-term growth.)
...Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne. (...So, as soon as I received my bonus, I rushed right over... and prepared to give half of it to you and your Bangboo.)
Huh?!
What a windfall!
Ehn-ne. Ehn-ne-ne. (This is the reward you deserve, and also my way of showing appreciation to a "partner." I hope you'll be pleased with it.)
Ehn-ne. (I look forward to our next collaboration, dear friend.)
Ehn-ne, ehn-ne. (We meet again, dear sir.)
Cody

Activity_GalGame_ActivityDetectiveV2_111: CCD Deputy Director Cora is holding a routine press conference. Amid a flurry of camera flashes, the Q&A session is coming to an end.
Hello, Deputy Director Cora. NEBC reports that some underground Inter-Knot group is illegally selling Carrot data that has not been registered with the city. What is the CCD's response to that?
No... That's not what I meant. I wasn't implying anything about Miss Velina...
Hm? Who said I was laughing? Please, do not worry. We are <color=#FFAF2C>descending on the target</color>, and I expect we shall have an answer for you very soon.
<color=#B5B5B5>(whisper) We are descending on the target, huh... I guess you could say they were in "over their heads"...</color>

Ahem. Not at all. Airspace Patrol conducts itself with the utmost professionalism. No matter how funny something may be, we never laugh. This concludes today's press conference. Thank you all for your time.
As soon as the news conference on TV ends, Cissia rushes into the room.
Ehn-ne, ehn-ne... (So Crowe posed as a Ridu bigshot and went to the islet to meet Tommy? But why hasn't he answered my messages...)
Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne! (Temporary Detective Assistants, I need you to pose as Carrot buyers and go to Vyrium at midnight. I'll support you from behind the scenes.)
From behind the scenes? Why not come and search together?

Ehn-ne, ehn-ne! (I have a great deal to consider, and besides, my health is poor. More importantly, I hear Ridu Bangboo don't wear clothes. If I joined you in disguise, I would have to remove my pants.)
Ehn-ne, ehn-ne! (Truth be told, that's why I didn't join Crowe in the first place. And now we've lost contact...)
Rain or shine, I'll wait for a buyer...
Ehn-ne, ehn-ne. (Exactly. It's Booastrum's most difficult puzzle of all: finishing the code phrase!)
Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne. (But I happen to know the second line. Back when I was investigating the En-Nah Gang, one of my informants overheard it nearby...)
Uh... Manager, I didn't get a word of that. Am I missing something?
Ehn-ne! Ehn-ne-ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne! (No, no. You heard me correctly. The second line is: "Ehn-ne-ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne!")
Ehn-ne! (Go forth, my invincible geniuses! The agency's future rests on the Temporary Detective Assistant and your pet. I shall be following discreetly behind you!)
Oh, stop. I'm just an average... Wait. Did you call me a PET?!
Rain or shine, I'll wait for a buyer...
Y—Y—You... Argh... I knew we shouldn't have trusted that hobbling Bangboo!
While you struggle to come up with an answer, you hear a familiar scoffing sound behind you...
In an instant, Airspace Patrol officers hiding in the alley leap out and charge toward Tommy.
But they are one step behind. Tommy has already loaded the goods onto a speedboat and is racing toward the Hollow...
But how did the Carrots get out?
Could someone have stolen CCD data?
We considered that possibility. Deputy Director Cora helped us inspect every Databoo's operating logs. All showed routine downloads and computation, followed by centralized uploads.
Crowe holds up a shipping label he tore off the cargo and stuffed in his pocket. It shows the name "Enbarr Express."
You find Master Song, manager of the Enbarr Express depot, and ask him to check the shipping label Crowe recovered...
Aren't we supposed to be investigating?
How did we end up taking a part-time job?
Exactly! But, weren't we supposed to be investigating? How did we end up with a part-time job?!
After Richboo reboots, Cissia and Crowe begin the interrogation, but it isn't going well...
Wuh-ne, wuh-ne! (Don't waste your breath. I won't tell you anything. Even if someone handed you ten courage cores, you still wouldn't dare touch me...)
Wuh-ne-ne! (Once I get out, I'll make every last one of you pay!)
One of us plays the good cop, and the other plays the bad cop. The little guy will feel the psychological tug-of-war, and its defenses will crumble in no time...
That might be going a little too far!
Wuh-ne! Wuh-ne-ne! (Help! They're gonna strip me naked! They're gonna ship me off to New Eridu and work me like a dog!)
The sheer shock seems to overwhelm Richboo, and he goes into a system crash...
We've got a bigger problem now...
Wuh-ne, wuh-ne-ne... (Could you two be a little more careful for once...?)
Wuh-ne, wuh-ne-ne! (A hole today, a torn corner tomorrow... Soon all the clothes I designed will be nothing but rags!)

Wuh-ne! Wuh-ne-wuh-ne! (What do you know? Behind every strand of thread lies a designer's ingenuity. Knit stitches are smooth and refined; purl stitches are soft and full of dimension. Their interplay embodies the designer's heart and soul.)
Wuh-ne! Wuh-ne-wuh-ne! (Dense rows of knit and purl, their ridges and valleys interlocking like lines of code. A finished garment carries more thought and information than the data on any chip!)
Kahkiboo's words set Crowe thinking, but before he can reach a conclusion, a video call from Sigrid comes through...
What's up, Deputy Director? Did Mr. Chandler finally come to his senses and confess?
Wait. Cissia is calling... What in the world is this? Why is Tommy surrounded by crates of <color=#FFAF2C>actual carrots</color>?
Ehn-ne-ehn-ne... (Ugh! What a disaster... We went looking for Carrot data and found <color=#FFAF2C>actual carrots</color> instead...)
Seems we're back at square one...
Ehn-ne... Ehn-ne-ne... (Will this case become a dark chapter in our agency's history...?)
No, no, no. This case is far from over. Temporary Detective Assistant, mind coming with me to the Enbarr Express office tomorrow?
You unpack the dolls from the Enbarr Express shipment and begin examining them with Crowe...
No, no, no. Look closer at the individual stitches, especially how she <color=#FFAF2C>alternates</color> to create those raised and recessed patterns.

Analysis in progress... Conclusion: Carrot data confirmed. It corresponds to a region of Cretan Hollow, but the dataset is incomplete.

Airspace Patrol has the strictest security screening standards. No data drive could pass through unnoticed, so the smuggled Carrots could not have left through an official exit...

BMW_CharacterDesc_37: A medical consultant for High Ambitions Corp., a young lady shrouded in mystery from head to toe.
BMW_CharacterDesc_38: A Judge of Krampus Compliance Authority, who has recently entered Roscaelifer.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_302002: Her life before coming to the island was rather unusual. After an argument with her family, she lied about being an orphan and joined the Marcel Group's treatment program, the Aurelia Academy, and has struggled to make a life for herself in Roscaelifer ever since.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_302503: She came to Vyrium for treatment, while using "Thaumiel" to keep Dracaene's condition stable. According to her, she seems to have long suspected that something was wrong with Sunbringer's identity. She just never told me the whole story... Remielle, Remielle, just how much information are you still keeping from me?
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_312602: During the events in Vyrium, she displayed the courage, decisiveness, and formidable strength expected of Sunbringer, who leads the Airspace Patrol Department. After the long-hidden secret that "Sunbringer is the Enchainer" came to light, her straightforward nature led her to open up to me and tell me everything... She promised that no matter what, she would remain the hero steadfastly committed to protecting Roscaelifer.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_313402: The Administrative Director of Flint Workshop and the current head of the Flint family, she stands as a top-tier talent in the field of Porcelloy forging. Though she comes across as haughty, she's all bark and no bite — always showing kindness to those close to her, and never truly counting the cost of what she gives.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3235: She always looks like she's running on empty, yet she never fails to have everything sorted out perfectly for Claret — a truly attentive and dependable assistant who goes above and beyond for her Master. Her heart is crafted from Porcelloy and requires regular intake of Flint blood... which means she's bound to the Flint family for life, doesn't it?
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3236: So it turns out... the mastermind behind all the schemes and conspiracies was Youkai, using the appearance of the late Serpico. During the events at Vyrium, Youkai set a trap that successfully drew away the attention of me, Lindverne and the others, working in tandem with an unidentified faction from the inside to seize control of Booastrum.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3237: First Cissia knocked her out by opening a door into her, then she fell straight from Booastum all the way down to Vyrium. Ever since meeting her, it seems I still haven't exchanged a single word with her while she's actually conscious... It's hard to imagine her official position is just an ordinary medical assistant. Is this what they mean by "what doesn't kill you makes you a better doctor"?
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3238: Deep within the Porcelloy Research Institute in Shrouded Reef, I encountered her again as she secretly investigated High Ambitions. Her presence meant he disciplinary branch representing the Krampus Compliance Authority had finally reached for its most disobedient child.

BMW_TreasureDesc_07:
The Bangboo prince fled his homeland, believing he could finally live a life of freedom.
Yet wherever he went, he was always met with the same sorrowful faces.
"Alas, it's all because of that cruel king!"
"Alas, it's all because of that dreadful kingdom!"
A group of wanderers took the Bangboo prince in, and together they crossed the barren land.
The Bangboo prince taught them how to identify gemstones, and at last they found a place to make a home amid the wasteland.
"This is a gemstone only the king can identify. How do you know its secret?"
"Because I come from that kingdom too. I am the Bangboo prince who fled from it."
The wanderers nodded silently and said nothing.
Yet when the Bangboo prince awoke the next morning, his former traveling companions had already slipped away under cover of night.

Later, the Bangboo prince met many more traveling companions, all of whom marveled at his vast knowledge.
Yet the moment they learned the truth, every encounter would come to an end.
Until one day, the Bangboo prince met a scholar.
The scholar quietly listened to the entire story, then said:
"What they fled from was never the Bangboo prince.
What they truly feared was the king whose blood runs in your veins,
and you, who may one day become king yourself.
Because this is how the kingdom endures. This is how the kingdom functions.
This is the established rule. This is the only answer."

No, no! There isn't just one rule in this world, nor is there only one answer.
I set out on this journey precisely because I wanted to change the fate that had already been decided!
Then become one of us, the scholar said.
We will defeat the Bangboo King and put an end to that cruel kingdom.
And you, too, will surely be able to find another answer,
a future where you no longer have to hide who you are.
BMW_TreasureDesc_08:
Having done all this, the Bangboo prince let out a soft sigh.
"Then let's go," he said to the star.
The star gave no answer, only quietly glowing with a faint light.
And so, cradling it in his arms, the Bangboo prince climbed the steps leading to the kingdom's high tower.
One step, two steps... He looked back at the kingdom one last time, at the place he had once hated with all his heart.
Three steps, four steps... Yet for the first time, he felt truly glad that he had been born a Bangboo prince.
And so, the tower that had once stood cold and imposing finally began to shine with a warm light.
From that day forward, it would no longer be a symbol of a cruel kingdom, but a beacon in the night.
Yes, a beacon... the Bangboo prince thought.
Now, at last, he no longer had to run anywhere.
Now, he could finally drift peacefully off to sleep.

CardDesc_10041:
The vanguard unit of the Roscaelifer Airspace Patrol Department, equipped with standard-issue greatswords forged from Porcelloy. The blades possess excellent Ether conductivity, capable of resonating with Ether to channel energy into the cutting edge and further enhance the weapon's lethality.

The patrol units of the Airspace Patrol Department are renowned for their ironclad discipline and efficient operations.
Members of the Airspace Patrol come from all walks of life, yet officers at the rank of lieutenant and above are predominantly drawn from a storied noble lineage — the de L'Azur family.
The family holds no hereditary claim to military rank; their standing today is owed largely to a longstanding tradition of grooming their children in tactics from an early age. Most of the younger generation see enlisting in the patrol as a natural rite of passage, and to be born a de L'Azur means one must stand as an irreproachable example among their ranks. "Don't you think this sword is... a little too heavy?" "Huh?! I thought I was just too weak, so I never dared say anything..."

CardDesc_30054:
An oversized combat unit deployed by High Ambitions Corp.
Staying true to the strategic principle of making the most of available resources, operatives salvaged large quantities of Porcelloy from Shrouded Reef to upgrade the Conqueror's structural materials.
Due to a lack of expertise in Porcelloy craftsmanship, the material wasn't perfectly integrated into the Mech's core framework — but thanks to its exceptional rigidity and structural strength, it still delivered a significant boost to the unit's defense and durability.

"Isn't Porcelloy supposed to be super rare? You can't just use it like sheet metal."
"Just tell me — does the new Mech look sick or what?"
CardDesc_30055:
High Ambitions Corp. has illegally seized the Porcelloy transfer station at Shrouded Reef, using it as a base to secretly stockpile a massive arsenal. The Conqueror series stands as the centerpiece of this operation — a core tactical unit combining exceptional mobility with devastating firepower, representing a milestone in TOPS's militarization of civilian Ether technology.
While the Conqueror possesses a degree of autonomous combat capability, the complexity of real battlefield conditions and tactical decision-making still demands an experienced pilot at the helm to unlock its full potential.

"Become the light... Become the light... Become the light..."
"...So you need to chant spells to pilot a Mech?"
CardDesc_40010:
An armored titan born from Nihility, drawn by primal whispers into the abyss, with sheer space-rending brutality, it peers at the Enchainer's power — desperate to forge an unripe vessel into a container for supreme evil.
Kusarikku, a newborn Enchainer larvae, moves under Youkai's guidance in an attempt to seize the Karma Core dwelling within Lindverne Sunbringer.
It wields an oversized greatsword and warhammer far beyond all reason — its ferocious onslaught churning Ether Vortexes and leaving brief, unstable spatial fissures in its wake. Yet a hunter's instinct lets it slip through that tangled web of fissures, its hulking frame dissolving into a ghostly phantom that devours lives.

"Gotta love spatial abilities — great for running when you're losing a fight... not that it ever needs to run."
CardDesc_40011:
High-Risk simulated units mapped from real combat data. Through deep reconstruction and overfitting of prototype combat logic, certain individuals have broken past conventional performance thresholds, presenting an extremely high level of combat threat.

Light descends before the agony.
Uncontrollable Ether erupts like a solar corona. The silhouette of what was once "human" is burned, disintegrated, and reshaped into an aberration resembling an Ethereal. Crystalline lenses tremble deep within their vision, spilling excess radiance — too bright, too close, as if someone had embedded the blazing sun into their eye sockets.
Consciousness wears thin amidst the burning.
The swing ends — like a reflex, like a habit, lacking even the concept of a target. There is only a suffocatingly familiar blankness, as if long ago, they had also lost their voice and weight like this, watching everything plummet amidst the light and heat. Those buried fragments surge upward along the residual flames: the cold glare of the lab table, the sudden uncontrollable force, the faces drained of life... The memories are sickeningly vivid, leaving indelible scorch marks on the mind.
...Who is calling out?
That voice pierces the roar of blood rushing in the ears, briefly striking a faded name and granting their consciousness a momentary respite. Before their sanity is completely incinerated, a choice must be made — don't bring about another disaster. Go away. Leave... leave...
...Where to? With whom? To do what?
......
...Ah, I think we did make a deal like that...
..."We shall catch the 'sun'."

"To think your original sin would lead me to new heights over a decade later... How ironic, you legacy of 'Helios'."

With enough Sharpness, and while Claret is not in the Crimson Inscription state, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Ep> to activate:
Transforms the forging hammer into the Blood Axe to slash the target enemy, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, Claret enters the Crimson Inscription state for 16s. While off-field, its duration no longer decreases. When Claret's attacks hit an enemy, if the enemy is defeated within 0.5s and Crimson Inscription's remaining duration is not 0, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 3s. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
During this skill, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Ep> to skip the slash and quickly chain into the alternate Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron and Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault.
After using this skill, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_Branch_01_Desc_Simple:
With enough Sharpness, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Ep> to activate: Enters the <Term:1000036></Term> state. Defeating enemies while in the Crimson Inscription state extends its duration.
After using this skill, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Ep> to chain into the alt Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron and Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault.
After using this skill, it can be chained into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_Branch_01_Title: EX Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Secret Forging Techniques
Claret_Skill_CounterAssist_Desc:
When Claret or the on-field character is about to be hit by certain enemies' Control Skills, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Engages the enemy in a power struggle. Win the struggle to neutralize the enemy's Control Skill and deal <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
<Term:1000036></Term>'s duration does not decrease during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_CounterAssist_Title: Counter Assist: Give Not an Inch of Steel
Claret_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Uses the hammer handle to deliver a powerful forward counterattack, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_Counter_Enhance_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Delivers a powerful forward counterattack with the Blood Axe, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
<Term:1000036></Term> will not end during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
<Term:1000036></Term>'s duration does not decrease, and the state does not end during this skill.
Upon activating this skill, gain 10 Sharpness.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_ExQTE_Desc_Simple:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain Sharpness. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
While in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Ep> to activate:
Performs a powerful upward slash forward, then follows up with a horizontal slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
If the horizontal slash hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, triggers Maim on the target, dealing additional AoE <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill. After successfully inflicting Maim, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc_Simple:
While in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
When the attack hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, it triggers Maim.
Claret_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
While in the <Term:1000036></Term> state and during the upward slash of Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Ep> to activate:
Performs three consecutive horizontal slashes forward, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Each horizontal slash that hits an enemy inflicted with Gash triggers Maim on the target, dealing additional AoE <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Up to 3 consecutive instances of Maim can be triggered during this skill, with the third having a higher Interrupt Level.
<Term:1000036></Term> will not end during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while using this skill. After successfully inflicting Maim, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc_Simple:
While in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
When this attack hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, it triggers Maim. Up to 3 consecutive instances of Maim can be triggered during a single use of this skill.
Claret_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to four strikes forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Claret_Skill_Normal_Enhance_04_Desc:
While in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, after launching Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron or Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault to trigger Maim, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Spins and leaps into the air with the Blood Axe, then slams down and slashes the target enemy, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered while leaping.
After using the skill, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
Claret_Skill_Normal_Enhance_04_Desc_Simp:
While in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, after using a Special Attack to trigger Maim, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate: A Perfect Dodge can be triggered during this skill:
After using this skill, it can be chained into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Claret_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> while in the <Term:1000036></Term> state to activate:
Performs up to three slashes forward with the Blood Axe, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the second attack is launched, Claret leaps backward and throws the Blood Axe. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered during the retreat.
When the third attack is launched, Claret performs a series of slashes before leaping up and performing a downward smash. During the repeated slashes, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Repeatedly press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to extend the duration of the repeated slashes. Stop pressing or release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to make Claret immediately leap up and perform a downward smash. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered while leaping. After successfully triggering a Perfect Dodge, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
Claret_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc_Simple:
While in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to perform up to three attacks.
A Perfect Dodge can be triggered when the second attack is launched.
When launching the third attack, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to extend the attack duration. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger a Perfect Dodge. After successfully triggering a Perfect Dodge, you can chain into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
Claret_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
<Term:1000036></Term>'s duration does not decrease during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_ParryAid_Title: Defensive Assist: Unyielding Heart of the Furnace
Claret_Skill_QTE_Desc:

Launches a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Launches a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Claret_Skill_Rush_Desc:
While not in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Dodge to activate:
Performs a forward hammer strike, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Claret_Skill_Rush_Enhance_Desc:
While in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Dodge to activate:
Slashes forward with the Blood Axe, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Claret_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches two bludgeoning attacks forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Claret_Skill_WrestleAid_Desc:
After using a <color=#FFFFFF>Counter Assist</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Deals massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. When the heavy attack hits an enemy, it adds one stack of Gash to the target.
<Term:1000036></Term>'s duration does not decrease during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Claret_Talent_01_Desc_01: When Claret's attacks hit enemies and trigger Laceration, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%. The DMG Multiplier of Maim triggered by Claret increases to 130% of its original value.
Claret_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
When Claret's attacks hit enemies and trigger Laceration, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%.
The DMG Multiplier of Maim triggered by Claret increases to 130% of its original value.
Claret_Talent_01_Desc_02:
The girl turns the pages of the weathered family chronicle, the coarse paper scraping at her palm.
A single drop of blood falls onto the title page; countless more stain every page that follows.
Claret_Talent_02_Desc_01: The maximum duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s. While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, attacks ignore 18% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.
Claret_Talent_02_Desc_01_Realign: The maximum duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s. While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, attacks ignore 18% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.
Claret_Talent_02_Desc_02:
The prodigy chosen by her bloodline steps into the great hall, radiant light spilling across her face.
Without a word, she accepts the crown and scepter, then turns and heads for the next forging ground.
Claret_Talent_03_Desc_02:
The forge burns day and night, and the family's heavy burden falls upon the young woman's shoulders.
She has never known how to ease the feelings weighing on her heart, until one day, her brilliant assistant brings her an exquisite dessert, adding a lingering touch of sweetness to her bitter days.
Claret_Talent_04_Desc_01: During the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging, the time by which the consecutive slashes can be extended is increased. DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging's 3rd hit, Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact, and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial increases by 20%.
Claret_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:
During the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging, the time by which the consecutive slashes can be extended is increased.
DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging's 3rd hit, Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact, and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial increases by 20%.
Claret_Talent_04_Desc_02:
The hammering falls silent, and only the crimson moon hangs high in the long night.
The young woman raises her scarlet gaze while the merciless moonlight seems to mock her as it creeps across the window frame.
Claret_Talent_05_Desc_02:
Generations of artisans have fed the furnace with their blood, but she swears to teach the flames to burn on their own.
The sound of hammering rings through the workshop once more. The furnace still burns eternal, but no longer needs life itself as fuel.
Claret_Talent_06_Desc_01: When the heavy attacks of Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial hit an enemy, Claret directly triggers 1 instance of single-target Maim without consuming Gash.
Claret_Talent_06_Desc_01_Realign: When the heavy attacks of Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial hit an enemy, Claret directly triggers 1 instance of single-target Maim without consuming Gash.
Claret_Talent_06_Desc_02:
The young woman finally drifts into a deep sleep.
She dreams of a full moon and a vast land stretching on forever.
The crimson moonlight has long since faded, and the silver night sky seems almost like dawn.
Claret_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
All DMG dealt by Claret's skills is considered Sharp DMG, and skill DMG Multipliers are based on DEF. Certain Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with Gash, which can stack up to 3 times. When Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron or Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault hits an enemy inflicted with Gash, 1 stack of Gash is consumed to trigger Maim and deal AoE DMG.
When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG doesn't receive the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead uses the Laceration DMG Bonus. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration is triggered, the Laceration DMG Bonus is applied an additional time. For every 1% of Claret's initial CRIT DMG, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%.
When Claret enters the battlefield, she gains 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Claret is in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, her Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. When Claret uses a Chain Attack, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 2s.
While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, or while using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> and Gash Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>. Triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging or Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe increases DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill by 15%.

Claret_UniqueSkill_Desc_Simple:
Claret's skill DMG multipliers scale with DEF. When she lands a CRIT, Laceration DMG is used in place of CRIT DMG for the DMG calculation. When CRIT Rate exceeds 100%, the excess CRIT Rate is used to make an additional Laceration check.
Claret's base CRIT DMG increases her CRIT Rate. Upon entering the battlefield, she gains Sharpness.
While Claret is in the <Term:1000036></Term> state, her Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and using a Chain Attack extends the duration of Crimson Inscription.
While Claret is in Crimson Inscription, or when using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, Counter Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, CRIT Rate and Gash Buildup Rate are increased. If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during a Basic Attack, DMG dealt is increased for the rest of that skill.
Claret_VHS: Consider these a loan for now — your shop's looking pretty dead in here... Hey! No need to freak out. I'm not giving them to you. You're paying me back!
ClueDesc_1069: A mechanical device crafted from Porcelloy. When installed into the spine of certain special Ethereals, it can restrain and control them.
ClueDesc_1070: A biometric access card specially issued to TOPS mercenary soldiers secretly stationed at the Shrouded Reef Transfer Station. Once the cardholder's vital signs cease, the card's access privileges are immediately revoked.
ClueDesc_310136: In the call, Crowe mentioned "Rain or shine, I'll wait for a buyer," and arranged to meet Tommy in Vyrium. And the goods they're dealing? Seem to be Carrots.
ClueDesc_310137: A partial call recording intercepted yesterday before the feed got cut. Chandler mentioned rotating drop points in a 1-2-3 cycle, with the next drop going through Port 2 at midnight tomorrow. Tommy pushed back, saying it should've been Port 1.
ClueDesc_310138: A recorded call between Chandler and Tommy from six days ago during a smuggling run. Sounds like Tommy was pulling contraband out of the water. You can also hear sewing machines and mechanical clanking in the background.
ClueDesc_310139: Chandler mentioned during the smuggling run that they have to switch to a different port every two days. In the background, you can hear the sounds of hover buses and dogs barking.
ClueDesc_310140: Tommy seemed to be talking with Chandler about meeting up with Crowe. You can hear the hum of hover buses and elevators in the background.
CollectionDesc_3700249:
A limited-edition toy crafted to mimic a W-Engine.

A specially modified W-Engine that's become hugely popular on Inter-Knot. Some functionality was sacrificed for the sake of its appearance, but that hasn't stopped it from becoming a massive hit.
Even its designer never expected it to be this successful. In an interview, he explained, "In the ever-changing Hollows, the anxiety brought on by uncertainty can easily overwhelm a person's will. For people trapped in desperate situations, even a small sign of good fortune can be enough to give them hope."
"Of course, maybe people just like cats." He added with a laugh at the end of the interview.
CollectionDesc_3700250:
A limited-edition toy crafted to mimic a W-Engine.

For as long as anyone can remember, tales and rumors about Flint have never ceased, enough to fill an entire collection of strange accounts. Blood, Porcelloy, long-buried history, inherited miracles... None of these dangerous secrets has ever been fully laid bare, yet they have always held the public's fascination. Curiously, the family head has never come forward to offer any explanation. Some say her ambitions reach too far for her to waste time on gossip. Some say she possessed a steady mind even in her youth and chose to let the rumors gather momentum. And some claim there were never any rumors about Flint to begin with, only truths passed down through the world. Rumors drift like fog, obscuring what is real and what is not. But toward that young family head, people feel nothing beyond reverence and fear.
CollectionDesc_3700251:

Intro_105900001: You watch the film "Oh~ Sweetie" together with Sigrid. A movie date, a heartbeat that quietly quickens, warmth that creeps into the cheeks — the essential ingredients of an old-fashioned date.
Intro_106900001: After trying out the new stages in Pinball Knight, you run into Claret and Roxy, who have just slipped out of a meeting. After a brief chat, Claret awkwardly hints that she'll be back again tomorrow.
Intro_106900002: {F#Belle}{M#Wise} cleared the stage with ease using a brand-new pinball, but Claret still failed the challenge. Things got awkward for a moment, but Roxy stepped in and smoothed things over. Inspired by the exchange between the two, Kahkiboo crafted a new marble modeled after Roxy.
Intro_106900003: Outside the Chic Bootique, you ran into Cissia, who was busy collecting bottle caps. After Kahkiboo gave her a bottle cap, Cissia joined in on designing the new pinball.
Intro_106900004: Kahkiboo's vision for the new pinball immediately brought Commissioner Severian to mind. After {F#Belle}{M#Wise} played a little prank on Cissia, Kahkiboo finished designing the new pinball.
Intro_106900005: While testing the machine, you noticed someone behind you. You turned around and, surprise, it was Remielle. Turns out she and Kahkiboo already knew each other! Since that's the case, let's design the new pinball together.
Intro_106900006: The pinball machine suddenly sprang to life, sending the pinballs into a frenzy. Yet somehow, they behaved exactly like their prototypes. This unexpected discovery was the perfect finale to Kahkiboo's Aesthetics Practice.
Intro_110600033: {M#Wise}{F#Belle} uses the evidence at hand to expose every one of Favco's cover-ups in one fell swoop.
Intro_111200001: Cora, the CCD's Deputy General Affairs Officer, was cornered by reporters asking about the Carrot smuggling case and found herself at a loss for words. Fortunately, Sigrid stepped in to help, stating that the Airspace Patrol was investigating the case.
Intro_111200002: After restoring the call recording, Hobble suggested they could pose as Carrot buyers and head to Vyrium to find Tommy, the contact Crowe was supposed to meet.
Intro_111200003: After successfully tracking down the Carrot dealer Tommy in Vyrium, Crowe appeared soon after. Sensing something was off, Tommy fled and narrowly escaped capture by Airspace Patrol.
Intro_111200004: At the CCD, Cora and Sigrid welcomed the group. It turned out that the CCD and Public Security were working together to investigate the Carrot smuggling case, and Severian filled everyone in on the details.
Intro_111200005: Master Song identifies the package as belonging to Chandler, the owner of an e-commerce company called "Boo & Beyond," but refuses to provide any further information. Thinking on his feet, Crowe decides to go undercover by applying for a job as a delivery driver.
Intro_111200006: After Richboo was rebooted, Cissia and Crowe began their interrogation, but things didn't go very well... Under the pressure of the questioning, Richboo got so spooked that he crashed. The group had no choice but to find Rona and ask for her help decrypting the data.
Intro_111200007: While mending clothes, the group receives a call from Sigrid and Cissia. It turns out that what Chandler and Tommy were smuggling wasn't data Carrots, but actual sweet, crunchy fruit carrots.
Intro_111200008: While examining the plushies Rona sent to the surface, the group discovered that the stitching on their surfaces used alternating knit and purl stitch patterns to encode binary data of 0s and 1s. After decoding it, they found that it was the Carrot data.
Intro_111200009: At the CCD, Rona finally confessed to her crimes. It turned out that her misjudgment had allowed Chandler to swindle away the Bangboo's savings. Overcome with guilt, she eventually took a desperate risk and resorted to smuggling Carrots.
Intro_123000006: Based on Claret's analysis of the Porcelloy evidence, the group concludes that Girtablullu is not a naturally occurring Ethereal, but an artificially created one, designed to serve a specific purpose. Meanwhile, more crucial clues may be waiting at a Porcelloy transfer station near Vyrium.
Intro_123000022: A mysterious figure falls from the sky and lands right in front of you... To {F#Belle}{M#Wise}'s surprise, it turns out to be Phoenix, the medical assistant from High Ambitions Corp. whom you encountered before.
Intro_123000030: Regarding the suspicious Porcelloy transfer station, Claret decides to send a specialized team to investigate. Meanwhile, Roxy is tasked with traveling to Booastrum and personally delivering the Porcelloy to Eldreda Sunbringer. Later, Lindverne and Remielle have a private conversation in the treatment room...
Intro_1721000004: Velina tells you that she'll use her leverage to buy Norma more time before the interpellation, but ultimately, it's on Norma to fix the root cause of the issue (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000005: Upon learning that Velina, Sigrid, and others were on their way to help, Remielle once again vanishes, taking her mysteries with her... (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000006: Remielle, who was waiting in your room, finally gives you more information, dropping the word Enchainer, something you've never heard before... (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000027: Norma gives everyone a quick rundown on Booastrum, the main island hub, and the overall situation in Roscaelifer. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000029: Everyone finds out from Velina that the treatment procedure would be personally overseen by Sunbringer. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000030: You confront your "other self" within, and make the decision to stop running — instead choosing to tame that power. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000031: As you explain to everyone how they dealt with the Singularity Leakage, Bangboo Luka from the External Strategy Department shows up asking for help, saying that Norma and some Bangboo are trapped at the central elevator... (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000034: From the Bangboo's conversation, maybe you can find out what Archy's costume looks like from the "King Laer" poster. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000035: From the Bangboo's conversation, you can confirm that Archy is currently wearing a fancy bicorne and a formal suit. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000036: Archy is on a remote call with someone who appears to be the Angel the Bangboo keep talking about... (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000038: After the group confirmed the Angel's Signal is coming from the CCD office area, it suddenly cuts out... (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1721000040: Through remote surveillance, the group learns that Archy's squad in Airspace Patrol is searching for squad member Toby. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1722000004: Remielle brings you, unconscious, back to her room and reveals that the exchange of memories between you was not the first time it happened. Remielle admits to killing her dearest friend, Beliora Vike, with her own hands, and, overcome with grief, she hastily bids you farewell. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1722000010: You rescue Remielle in the guise of Pyrois, and the two officially become true partners in crime in every sense of the word. You help Remielle understand that she is not alone in this era. After promising to meet again, you two return to your respective places for the time being. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1722000013: You reunite with Truvia, a close childhood friend you'd been estranged from for years. The conversation is distant and awkward, but Sigrid seems to misread the tension of this reunion. Under her arrangements, you find yourself alone with Truvia once again. (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_1722000016: You and Remielle position yourselves directly above the banquet hall, ready to make your move. With Girtablullu yet to show, Remielle suddenly suggests you share a dance before the music ends. And so, the two partners in crime reach out and take each other's hands... (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)
Intro_2122000002: Lindverne and Sigrid arrive, along with soldiers and foreign guests. It is only at this moment that you realize Remielle has been trying to take all the blame. But as this play nears its final act, Remielle suddenly finds herself unable to suppress the Enchainer transformation any longer... (Note: This dialogue cannot be replayed in the Video Archive.)

Item_Weapon_A_Common_17_Desc:
A specially modified W-Engine that's become hugely popular on Inter-Knot. Some functionality was sacrificed for the sake of its appearance, but that hasn't stopped it from becoming a massive hit.
Even its designer never expected it to be this successful. In an interview, he explained, "In the ever-changing Hollows, the anxiety brought on by uncertainty can easily overwhelm a person's will. For people trapped in desperate situations, even a small sign of good fortune can be enough to give them hope."
"Of course, maybe people just like cats." He added with a laugh at the end of the interview.

Item_Weapon_B_Common_16_Desc:
A W-Engine improved upon the first three generations of the "Lunar" series, offering advantages in output power, noise reduction, and energy capacity.
Unfortunately, each individual metric is slightly weaker than its predecessors, making it a precisely balanced "jack-of-all-trades" product that inspires both love and hate.
Item_Weapon_B_Common_16_ShortDesc: A cost-effective choice for newcomers exploring Hollows.
Item_Weapon_S_1611_Desc:
For as long as anyone can remember, tales and rumors about the Flint family have never ceased, enough to fill an entire anthology of rumors. Blood, Porcelloy, long-buried history, inherited miracles... None of these dangerous secrets have ever been fully laid bare, yet they have always held the public's fascination. Curiously, the family head has never come forward to offer any explanation. Some say her ambitions reach too far for her to waste time on gossip. Some say she possessed a steady mind even in her youth and chose to let the rumors gather momentum. And some claim there were never any rumors about Flint to begin with, only truths passed down through the world. Rumors drift like fog, obscuring what is real and what is not. But toward that young family head, people feel nothing beyond reverence and fear.
"Roxy, the ruby in this W-Engine looks pretty valuable. If we sold it..." "Milady, forgive me for saying so, but I'm afraid it wouldn't even cover the losses from a single meeting between you and Lady Lindverne."
—The family head struggling with a budget shortfall and her capable assistant

Larval_NounPrompts_01_Des: After Kusarikku slips into a spatial fissure, it unleashes a series of powerful attacks. Use <color=#FFAF2C>Defensive Assists</color> to counter them and rapidly reduce its <Term:2000001></Term>. Repeatedly countering them successfully can allow you to seize the initiative in battle.
LevelDescText202: Depending on the off-field characters' type of <color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Assist</color>, when an enemy uses specific types of attacks, a <color=#FFAF2C>golden flash</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>red flash</color> prompt will appear. For a short time after, press {LAYOUT_MOBILE#<IconMap:Icon_Switch>}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#<Action:InLevelSwitchAvatar>}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#<Action:InLevelSwitchAvatar>} to switch to the next Agent and trigger a <color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Assist</color>.
LevelDescText20202:
<color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Assist</color> is divided into two types:
When enemies attack and a <color=#FFAF2C>gold flash</color> appears, and upon meeting the requirements, a <color=#FFAF2C>Defensive Assist</color> can be triggered. <color=#FFAF2C>Defensive Assists</color> can block enemy attacks, accumulate a large amount of Daze, and interrupt most attacks. They are suitable for dealing with most <color=#FFAF2C>melee attacks</color>;
When enemies attack and a <color=#FFAF2C>red flash</color> appears, and upon meeting the requirements, an <color=#FFAF2C>Evasive Assist</color> can be triggered. <color=#FFAF2C>Evasive Assists</color> can evade enemy attacks and trigger <color=#FFAF2C>Vital View</color>, slowing down the actions of enemies within range. They are suitable for dealing with <color=#FFAF2C>ranged attacks</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>attacks that need to be dodged</color>.
LevelDescText20204:
Triggering <color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Assist</color> consumes <color=#FFAF2C>Assist Points</color>. The amount consumed is affected by attack intensity and character performance. When a character uses a <color=#FFAF2C>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>1</color> Assist Point is restored.
When <color=#FFAF2C>Assist Points</color> are insufficient, the flash prompt will be fixed as a <color=#FFAF2C>red flash</color>. Note: When an enemy launches specific attacks, press {LAYOUT_MOBILE#<IconMap:Icon_Switch>}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#<Action:InLevelSwitchAvatar>}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#<Action:InLevelSwitchAvatar>} within a short period of time after the <color=#FFAF2C>red flash</color> prompt appears to switch to the next character and trigger <color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Dodge</color>. Additionally, when an enemy launches specific attacks, if the skill cannot be responded to by any character in the team with the <color=#FFAF2C>Defensive Assist</color> skill, the flash prompt will also be fixed as a <color=#FFAF2C>red flash</color> prompt. With sufficient Assist Points, press {LAYOUT_MOBILE#<IconMap:Icon_Switch>}{LAYOUT_CONTROLLER#<Action:InLevelSwitchAvatar>}{LAYOUT_KEYBOARD#<Action:InLevelSwitchAvatar>} shortly after a <color=#FFAF2C>red flash</color> prompt to switch to the next character. If that character has the <color=#FFAF2C>Evasive Assist</color> skill, <color=#FFAF2C>Evasive Assist</color> will be triggered; otherwise, <color=#FFAF2C>Perfect Dodge</color> will be triggered.
LevelDescText307:
All DMG dealt by Armorer Characters is considered <color=#FFAF2C>Sharp DMG</color>, using <color=#FFAF2C>DEF</color> as the skill DMG Multiplier.
When a CRIT is triggered, Sharp DMG is not affected by CRIT DMG Bonus. Instead, Laceration DMG Bonus is applied. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a CRIT has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check will be performed based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration triggers, an extra instance of Laceration DMG Bonus is applied.
Sharp DMG accumulates <color=#FFAF2C>Gash</color>. When Gash is full, the enemy is inflicted with <color=#FFAF2C>Gash</color>. <color=#FFAF2C>Gash</color> can stack up to 3 times.
LevelDescText30702: When an enemy has 1 or more stacks of <color=#FFAF2C>Gash</color>, hitting them with specific skills can consume <color=#FFAF2C>Gash</color>, triggering <color=#FFAF2C>Maim</color> to deal bonus DMG.

MessageItem_4000214_detail:
To My Daughter, Kate,

When someone from the Marcel Group came to our door and told me that you were alive, I just sat here for a long time. I couldn't say a word.

All these years since you left home and disappeared, I've had the same thought over and over: What if I'll never see my daughter again? I've thought so many times about what I'd say if I ever got the chance to see you again. But now that I finally have the chance to write to you, I don't even know where to begin. So I'll just say this: Thank goodness you're alive.

We've been looking for you all this time. The day you left, your father and I thought you were just angry and would come home after a few days. Then it was one day, two days, a week... and you still didn't come back.
We searched everywhere we could. We went to places you used to visit, asked your old classmates, and even tracked down the Hollow raiders who went into the Hollow with you. Whenever we heard anything that might have been connected to you, we went looking.
Now that I know you've joined the Marcel Group's treatment program, I can finally breathe a little easier.
How have you been all these years? Have you been eating well? Have you made any new friends? And... do you still resent your father and me?
Kate, I'm sorry.
I've owed you those words for so many years.
Back then, your father and I were poor. Every day, all we could think about was making enough money to keep the family going. We forgot to stop and ask how you and your younger siblings were doing.
As the oldest child, you naturally took on all the housework. We were always telling you how sensible and responsible you were. We were so proud of how "grown-up" you were that we forgot something very important.
You were still a child.
I wasn't a good enough mother.
I let my daughter carry burdens no child your age should ever have had to bear. And I never once stopped to ask if you were tired, or if things were too hard for you.
I didn't even realize when you stopped going to school. I didn't know you had started going into those dangerous Hollows with the Hollow raiders just to earn money and help support the family.
By the time we found out, you had already contracted Corruptions.
We had a terrible argument that day. Your father and I said so many things to you. And then, not long after that, you left home.
When I think back on it now, not one of the things I said that day was meant to protect you.
If I'd only asked you first, "Has it been too hard?"...
Would you still have left?
But please don't worry about us anymore. Things at home have slowly gotten better over the years. The children don't have to carry grown-up responsibilities anymore.
Your brother and sister still remember that they have an older sister. At first, they used to ask me all the time, "When is Sis coming home?"
They don't ask as often anymore.
But they still miss you.
You're such a strong and wonderful girl. I'm sure you've made a new life for yourself with the Marcel Group by now.
If you're happy where you are, then stay there. Live the life that makes you happy.
But if you ever find it in your heart to forgive us, then... whenever you miss home, come back and see us.
Even if it's only for a meal. Even if you just come by to see your family.
That dinnerware set you always loved is still here, you know. We never got rid of it.
And if you're still not ready to see us, that's okay, too.
Just write back.
Tell us you're safe. That's all I need.
I don't expect you to forgive us right away. I know there are some wounds that can't be healed by simply saying, "I'm sorry."
But I still hope you'll give your mother a chance.
A chance to give you all the things I failed to give you back then.
No matter what happened in the past, and no matter how far you've gone, you'll always be my daughter.
The door will always be open for you.
With all my love,
Maya

OokumaMari_MathSkill_Enhance_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Armorer</color> character, or shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When the explosion from Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, it applies a debuff to the target. While the target is Stunned, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> deal 35% more DMG to the target. This effect can stack up to 2 times and resets when the Stunned effect ends.
OokumaMari_Skill_Counter_Enhance_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and creates an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. If Koleda has <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to follow up with an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
OokumaMari_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When Koleda has the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect, she can launch an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> after the 2nd hit, consuming the <color=#FFFFFF>Furnace Fire</color> effect and dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.

When Koleda and Ben are both in the squad, using an enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> without switching Agents during the first hit of the enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> causes the two to perform a Coordinated Attack, further increasing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and her enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

POText_713:
In <color=#FFAF2C>"Union"</color> stages, focus on different <color=#FFAF2C>"buffs"</color> and keep meeting <color=#FFAF2C>Trigger Requirements</color> to stack <color=#2BAD00>"combat buff" effects</color> and defeat powerful enemies.

PartnerTalk_BubbleStory_PartnerRoxy_3406: What a weird sculpture... I don't get why Bangboo think it can actually grant wishes...
PartnerTalk_ChatAudio_PartnerClaret_3306: Hey... You don't think I'm just being picky, do you?
And the cake... eh, let's just skip it today. It'd just remind me of something I'd rather forget...
People say the moon over Vyrium is blood-red... that we hold secret gatherings of vampires...
...Huh? Why are you staring at me? Don't tell me I've still got pillow marks on my face...
Oh, no... I knew I shouldn't have slept in! I should've checked before I left... Ugh, and Roxy's no help! She could've at least told me!
I've been reading the journals left behind by the previous heads of the family... and I realized they all wrestled with the same question I do.
Heh, can't believe I'm saying something this pathetic... Just forget it. I was only venting.
PartnerTalk_ChatAudio_PartnerRoxy_330620: It's rare for milady and I to have a chance to kick back and enjoy afternoon tea.
Oh, did you notice? I guess that was a long winded way of saying you're my distinguished guest.
Of course, you are also a distinguished guest of Flint Workshop. That goes without saying.
People always tend to pay attention to what's more eye-catching, more special.
And then there's me, utterly unremarkable, always by milady's side... people often describe me as nothing more than her "tool."
Ever since we were little, she has protected me more times than I can count. She has always treated me with dignity.
Come to think of it, the Academy has been requesting Porcelloy from milady quite frequently... They've accumulated a rather considerable debt by now.
PartnerTalk_ChatAudio_PartnerSigrid_3305: But you... Your story doesn't end here, Wise. Your steed is destined to carry you toward horizons far beyond my sight.
PartnerTalk_Chat_PartnerClaret_330610012: ...Or rather, I have to dedicate some time to careful accounting each month just to keep the workshop afloat...
PartnerTalk_Chat_PartnerClaret_330610022: Oh no, don't give me that look... You understand me, right, Miss?
PartnerTalk_Chat_PartnerRoxy_330620008_0: So they all owe Flint money?
PartnerTalk_Chat_PartnerRoxy_330620008_1: But Belle, it looks like you're on Flint's debtor list now too, huh?
But Wise, it looks like you're on Flint's debtor list now too, huh?
PartnerTalk_Chat_PartnerRoxy_330620015_1: Ah, I see... but Roscaelifer is already a city up in the sky. Do people really ride this just to see the scenery from even higher up?
PartnerTalk_Chat_PartnerRoxy_330620026_2:
The two little Bangboo start arguing, but fortunately, Roxy steps in and puts a stop to it.
In the end, they stomp off noisily, still unconvinced, waving their round little fists at each other.
What an energetic pair... It seems their worries about the "paranormal incident" have completely disappeared.
At least no trouble was caused!
The only troubling part is... I'll have to be more mindful of how I look when I'm heading home late after working overtime from now on...
Clock out early and get some rest!
PartnerTalk_Chat_PartnerRoxy_330620026_3: What a shame... I was hoping we'd stumble onto a real urban legend...
PartnerTalk_GalGame_PartnerClaret_106100:
You and Claret watch "Blood Feast," a vampire movie infamous for its over-the-top bloodshed and stylized gore despite its mediocre reviews.
Throughout the entire movie, Claret remains serious, studying every scene with intense concentration...
Hmph. Still cracking jokes? I won't let you back out of this later, got it?
And then, the two of you proceed with the experiment in a perfectly proper and scientific manner...
I mean, normal blood usually has at least a little metallic taste, right? Yours doesn't. Actually... it was almost... kind of good?
I mean, normal blood usually tastes a little metallic, right? Yours doesn't. Actually... it was almost... kind of good?
...Excuse me? Tastes good?! Who asked about that? Could you please take this a little more seriously?!
As you're conducting the experiment once again, an emotionless voice suddenly breaks the silence...
Roxy quietly excuses herself, thoughtfully closing the door behind her on the way out.
Ahaha... I sure do wonder why...
"This young lady?" You two seem pretty formal with each other... From what I've heard, you're supposed to be quite the lovey-dovey couple...
The contact finishes the exchange with Claret and hurries off.
Hmm, counterfeit, just as I thought...
I don't see it that way.
Who would've thought the buyer would turn out to be a c—couple... and insist on inspecting the goods together? I'd already come this far... I couldn't let this whole thing fall apart!
I'd be happy to help with the investigation.
Is that so... If only I could be as optimistic as you.
Every head of the family before me tried and failed... You have a little too much confidence in me, don't you think?
So why are you so certain? Because people call me a genius smith?
I never saw it that way.
So... am I the first person you've told about this?
What're you so happy about? It's not like this is some kinda secret...
But she's still a dependable family head.

Growl...
An awkwardly timed rumble cuts through the silence.
Ah... I'm getting hungry all of a sudden. Want to stop by Cuppa Moment later? I've been wanting to try their new desserts.
Ah... I'm getting hungry all of a sudden. Want to stop by Cuppa Moment later? I've been wanting to try their new desserts.
If you're not really up for it...
PartnerTalk_GalGame_PartnerPryce_1062000: What an unfortunate coincidence...
You've had a long day, Roxy.
It's a fun movie.
I hope it would help you unwind.
"Never Overtime" is a silly comedy. I was hoping it would help you unwind after a long day at work.
I'm getting fired up!
I don't know why but I'm fired up!

"Never Overtime" is a workplace comedy—
The protagonist, an employee who can never clock out on time, decides to rebel against the shady corporation he works for, Olympus.
To this end, he fearlessly waged a (not-so-)epic war against a host of deities, including "Teambuilding Goddess Athena," "Overtime Fitness Nut Ares," and "Holder of Overnight Meetings Hermes"!

PostText_32001:
The mini-game I promised you all, "Echoes of the Hollow," is finally live today!
As everyone knows, I am a HUGE fan of Hoshimi Miyabi, Chief of HSOS 6, so this game is basically a fan-made work starring Miyabi herself.
Honestly, I started out just wanting to make some casual fan content featuring Miyabi — but before I knew it, I'd drawn nearly 3,000 character sketches... And it is SO not my fault, okay?! The moment I see Miyabi in combat, I just can't help but want to recreate every single one of those moments in the game! Sure, I may have lost a serious amount of hair pulling all-nighters, but the second I see Miyabi's gorgeous hair flowing with perfect physics in-game, I forgive everything!
Anyway, as a thank-you for all your support — and as a gift to every Miyabi fan out there just like me — this game is completely, totally, 100% FREE! Please download it and show your support! Share this super adorable Miyabi experience with the whole world!
PostText_32002:
No filters, no edits — straight out of the camera. Don't believe me? Feel free to close this post. No doubters allowed!
So today, just like any other day, I headed out to the terrace of my family's villa. With ten maids attending to my every need, I was all set to enjoy a hand-ground coffee, take in the evening glow, and have myself another blissfully ordinary day... But then, I spotted a shooting star streaking across the sky! Even someone as well-traveled and worldly as myself had never witnessed anything like it. So naturally, I'm sharing this rare spectacle with all of you!

Pryce_Talent_01_Desc_02:
Roxy always manages to keep everything perfectly in order, from the head of the household's daily needs to her frequent whims.
"If you insist on going, please take this guide with you. Yes, I knew you would make this decision, milady."
"You've changed your mind? That's fine. Here's another guide, just for this sort of situation."

<color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color> deals 5% more Daze.
For each <color=#ffffff>Eye of the Storm</color> detonated, gain 1 stack of <color=#ffffff>Windflow</color>, up to 3 stacks.
During <color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color>, if Roxy switches out after entering the <color=#ffffff>Whirlwind</color> state, she consumes all <color=#ffffff>Windflow</color>. Each stack consumed sustains the <color=#ffffff>Whirlwind</color> state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s.
When <color=#ffffff>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color> hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.
