Pryce_Talent_02_Desc_02:
Roxy's pale complexion and ever-present dark circles speak to how much effort she pours into the workshop.
She is all too familiar with Vyrium at four in the morning, despite having no nocturnal habits.
To her, clocking out feels as distant as a myth.
"Ah... dawn again... It feels like getting off work will never become a reality."
Pryce_Talent_03_Desc_02:
Roxy is used to making thorough plans, but whenever Claret is involved, those plans struggle to keep up with the changes. Countless schedule adjustments, countless revisions...
Even the perfect assistant eventually starts to lose her patience until she reaches a certain breaking point — and snaps.
From then on, Vyrium gains a terrifying figure who roams the streets late at night.
"I just want to go home... and get a good night's sleep—!"
Pryce_Talent_04_Desc_01: When a <color=#ffffff>Defensive Assist</color> successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill. When <color=#ffffff>Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy</color> hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill. <color=#ffffff>Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial</color> deals 20% more DMG and 10% more Daze.
Pryce_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign:
When a <color=#ffffff>Defensive Assist</color> successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill.
When <color=#ffffff>Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy</color> hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill.
<color=#ffffff>Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial</color> deals 20% more DMG and 10% more Daze.
Pryce_Talent_04_Desc_02:
Whenever Roxy brings out her weapon, her enemies are always left baffled: Who uses a coffin as a weapon?
Their confusion never lasts long, though.
Once they see the girl casually swing it around, tearing through the air with a heavy howl, they quickly understand: that thing definitely wasn't made for sleeping in.
"It's still daytime, but I'm afraid... it's time to say goodnight."
Pryce_Talent_05_Desc_02:
Roxy can barely remember the adventure she had as a child, and the pain of losing her heart has long since faded.
But she will never forget how the girl known as a genius once cried until her proud eyes were red, calling Roxy's name over and over.
Her tears fell upon Roxy's cold chest, almost hot enough to burn a hole through her heart.
"Because of this Porcelloy Heart... I do get a little anemic sometimes, but with milady around, there's nothing to worry about."
Pryce_Talent_06_Desc_01:
The DMG dealt by attacks ignores 15% of the target's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind RES</color>.
When <color=#ffffff>Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off</color> detonates <color=#ffffff>Eyes of the Storm</color> to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with <color=#ffffff>Afterecho</color>. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of <color=#ffffff>Afterecho</color>. The DMG dealt by the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by 20%.

The DMG dealt by the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by 20%.
Pryce_Talent_06_Desc_02:
Some believe Roxy only remains by the head of the household's side to sustain her Porcelloy Heart: Flint Workshop used their bloodline to secure a capable assistant.
Roxy has heard such claims so often that she no longer even bothers refuting them. The other person concerned, however, can't help but worry over it.
One day, during a brief lull in her busy schedule, she casually brought the matter up with her assistant, only to be met with a helpless sigh.
"No, I've never thought of it that way. Just being alive is already more than enough. I've always been grateful to you, milady."
"Besides... if I may be so bold, aren't you the one bound by bloodline here, milady?"
"So this is what's been making you restless lately... Rather than some pointless rumor, I'd say that oversized Porcelloy order you boasted to the CCD about not long ago is far more worth worrying about."

QuestDesc_231083102: Doppelganger: Starlight Billy's ambush has brought the elevator to a halt, and even the Etheric Phantom Device can't be activated due to its Ether interference. Defeat it and restart the elevator.
QuestDesc_231083103: Open the Reverb Vessel at the end of the elevator ride and see what supplies Doppelganger: Starlight Billy left behind.
QuestDesc_232450101: A familiar voice comes from behind the iron gate at the Shrouded Reef Transfer Station. It's the same old Kabka, stuck in the same old predicament. Go see what's going on.
QuestDesc_232450102: With just a tap, Kabka is freed. But why did he come here in the first place, only to end up trapped behind the gate? Ask him what happened.
QuestDesc_232450103: Kabka mentions the room where the hidden picture book is kept. That's why he came here in the first place. Now that you have the key card, go check out the room with him.
QuestDesc_232450104: The room can't be accessed directly. Try hacking a nearby device to gain access.
QuestDesc_232450201: Sounds like a kid over there is calling out for help. Go see what's going on.
QuestDesc_232450202: In the direction the on-duty Bangboo is looking... a Bangboo is swimming in the water! Is that the drowning Bangboo the little girl mentioned? Hurry over and take a look.
QuestDesc_232450203: With the lost Denny in hand, go to the bridge and meet the flower-selling Bangboo to exchange it for clues about the Terminal Device.
QuestDesc_232450204: According to the flower-selling Bangboo, the painter who bought the Terminal Device should be near the workshop. Go look for him.
QuestDesc_232450205: The competition to find the picture book is fierce. Hurry and find the art collector. Hopefully, he hasn't sold the Terminal Device yet.
QuestDesc_232450206: The Terminal Device has already been bought by someone else. Head toward the warehouse and look for Miss Wendy.
QuestDesc_232450207: It turns out the young lady before you is the real Wendy. Talk to her and ask if you can take a look at the torn picture book pages in the Terminal Device.
QuestDesc_232450208: You've finally found the Terminal Device. Try unlocking it and check the picture book pages this time.
QuestDesc_232450209: You found the picture book pages this time without any trouble. Discuss them with everyone.
QuestDesc_232470101: Whenever you're at Amber Hall, remember to say hello to Bonnie!
QuestDesc_232470102: The academy is really lively today. Looks like Norma was right. Practicum Day really is an important event at the academy. Find someone who knows what's going on and learn more about it.
QuestDesc_232470103: The first stop is Cuppa Moment. Two students from Amber Hall are helping out there. While you finish the task, take the chance to say hello to them.
QuestDesc_232470104: The next stop is Boom Scones. Go find the owner, Maple Syrup, and have him sign for the delivery.
QuestDesc_232470105: The last delivery is for Fenella. Deliver the package, then report today's progress to her.
QuestDesc_232480101: The Fuzzy Wrench's manager, Zeppelin, seems to have something on her mind. Ask if she needs any help!
QuestDesc_232480102: There may be clues about the Bangboo Zeppelin is searching for near the mailbox she often uses... Search the area and see what you can find.
QuestDesc_232480103: Wait until midnight, then head to the Wishing Well in Central Park and see if you can find any clues.
QuestDesc_232480104: Since the suspicious Slenderboo ran up the stairs, look around the area and search for clues.
QuestDesc_232480105: Prophetboo might know something about Slenderboo. Go to the En-Nah Gang's hideout and see what you can find out.
QuestDesc_232480106: With the information from Prophetboo, you've found Slenderboo. But this strange Bangboo seems to be up to something big...
QuestDesc_232480107: Bring Slenderboo (in Mr. Roar's costume) to Zeppelin and explain everything that happened.
QuestDesc_232480108: Bring Slenderboo (in Mr. Roar's costume) to Zeppelin and explain everything that happened.
QuestDesc_232480109: Prophetboo might know something about Slenderboo. Go to the En-Nah Gang's hideout and see what you can find out.
QuestDesc_4230205: The residence ahead is the Flint family head's mansion for receiving guests, and Remielle seems to know it well. Talk to her about that before heading in.
QuestDesc_4230210: Lost track of the target mid-chase... but there's only one path through here, so they've gotta be nearby. Keep looking!
QuestDesc_516110101: You invite Claret to spend time together. Let's confirm the destination and create some unforgettable memories together.
QuestDesc_516110201: You invite Claret to spend time together. Let's confirm the destination and create some unforgettable memories together.
QuestDesc_516110301: You invite Claret to spend time together. Let's confirm the destination and create some unforgettable memories together.
QuestDesc_601100703: Today's letters are locked and loaded! Let's start delivering~
QuestDesc_601110115: Try Pinball Knight's Challenge Mode! Rack up a high score within the time limit and push yourself to the limit!
QuestDesc_601110213: Data Collection complete. Head back to Chic Bootique for the next move.
QuestDesc_601120103: Turns out Hobble comes looking for help because Crowe went dark after heading to Vyrium. After recovering Crowe's call records, you find out his contact was a Carrot dealer named Tommy. Chat with Hobble and figure out the next move.
QuestDesc_601120104: The crew decides to go undercover as Carrot dealers and head to Vyrium to link up with a seller named Tommy. The goal is to sniff out any trace of Crowe. Follow the signal from the Sonic Transcription Tracker and pick up Tommy's trail.
QuestDesc_601120202: You've arrived at the CCD entrance, but it looks like you'll need to pass a security check before heading in. Go chat with the Security Guardboo.
QuestDesc_601120203: Looks like the Security Guardboo has crashed due to a cache overload. You need to fix the wiring on his cache unit before it can let everyone through the security check.
QuestDesc_601120210: The Bangboo that tried to attack the group is knocked out after Crowe counters it, and Chandler has since vanished without a trace. Crowe notices the Bangboo's recording terminal is still running, so he decides to take it back to the detective agency to analyze the audio it has captured. Check in with Crowe on the analysis progress and piece together what you know so far.
QuestDesc_601120211: Chandler's subordinate, Richboo, still needs some time to reboot. After sorting through the Truth Journal, figure out the next move with everyone.
QuestDesc_601120301: Crowe and Cissia are waiting outside the detective agency, and Richboo seems still frozen. Head over and find out what's going on.
QuestDesc_601120302: Looks like Crowe fumbled the reboot sequence, and now Richboo's restart verification has failed. You need to hack past the security check to get him back up and running.
QuestDesc_601120303: After Richboo was rebooted, Cissia and Crowe begin their interrogation, but it doesn't go so well... Under the pressure of the questioning, Richboo gets so spooked that he crashes. Now the crew has no choice but to track down Rona for help cracking the data.
QuestDesc_601120304: Surprisingly, Rona actually pulls it off and restores the data, then breaks down how the Bangboo cache works. All that's left is tweaking the audio file frequency to recover the call recording.
QuestDesc_601120305: The audio file mentions some shipping intel: "1-2-3 cycle" and "switch to Port 2 this time." Chat with Crowe and the crew to figure out what it all means and map out Chandler's smuggling patterns.
QuestDesc_601120306: After mapping out Chandler's smuggling pattern, which is Ports 1-2-3 alternating every other day, Crowe decides to track down Port 3 first. Based on the background noise in the audio, the crew figures it's somewhere on Beckford Street. Load the infrasound into the Sonic Transcription Tracker and hunt down Chandler's drop point Port 3.
QuestDesc_601120307: After successfully locating Port 3, the crew tracks down a recording tied to Port 2 and heads near Emerald Central Park. Load the infrasound into the Sonic Transcription Tracker and locate Port 2, Chandler's next drop point.
QuestDesc_601120308: You've recovered Richboo's audio files and tracked down the three smuggling drop points. The crew regroups outside the detective agency to start piecing together everything they've dug up.
QuestDesc_601120309: Truth Journal sorted. Time to chat with Crowe about what's next.
QuestDesc_601120401: Per Sigrid's plan, you'll be heading to Emerald Central Park with Hobble and Crowe to stake out Chandler, who's about to make a smuggling run. They're waiting outside the detective agency. Go link up with them.
QuestDesc_601120402: All set. Next up is heading to Emerald Central Park to set up surveillance and stake out the area.
QuestDesc_601120404: Use drones and security cameras to tail Fugui, Chandler's Bangboo employee, and track down Chandler's whereabouts.
QuestDesc_601120405: Chandler's been tossing crates off Booastrum one by one. Catch him red-handed!
QuestDesc_601120406: During the early-morning raid, Hobble's clothes get torn. Head over to the Chic Bootique with Crowe and the crew to patch up the clothes and talk through the case while you're at it.
QuestDesc_601120407: While patching up clothes, the group receives a call from Sigrid and Cissia. Turns out, what Chandler and Tommy were smuggling wasn't data Carrots, but actual sweet, crunchy fruit carrots. Crowe seems to have already drawn some conclusions, though. Go have a chat with him first.
QuestDesc_601120502: Following Crowe's lead, the crew sets out to track down Master Song.
QuestDesc_601120503: Master Song's not where he used to be. Tap into the nearby security cameras and see if you can track him down.
QuestDesc_601120504: You've got Master Song's location locked down. Head over to True Blues and track him down.
QuestDesc_601120505: After brushing off Master Song, meet up with Crowe at Amber Hall. Chat with him and get ready to analyze the cargo you've picked up.
QuestDesc_601120506: While examining the plushies Rona sent down to the surface, the crew notices that the stitching on the plushies' surfaces used alternating forward and reverse stitch patterns to encode binary data in 0s and 1s. Once decoded, it turns out to be Carrot data. Chat with Crowe and wrap up the final entry of Truth Journal!
QuestDesc_601120507: The Truth Journal is all sorted out. Chat with Crowe about what's next, then head to the CCD to expose the real smuggler!
QuestDesc_601120509: You've overheard through the camera feed that Master Song is heading to True Blues. Chat with Crowe and get ready to head out.
QuestDesc_601120601: Just when it seems like everything has settled down, Crowe reaches out a few days later, asking to meet up on Gear Street. Looks like there is another special commission in the works.
QuestDesc_601120602: With everything settled, Crowe gives a quick rundown on Rona's situation and says he wants to deliver the new Profession Chips to the Bangboo who got scammed. Tag along for the first delivery to its destination: The Fuzzy Wrench.
QuestDesc_601120603: First delivery done! Crowe says Master Song needs everyone to meet up with two other new couriers near the Ferris wheel. Go check it out.
QuestDesc_601130301:
Cody is already waiting outside Amber Hall!
Let's see what this enthusiastic salesperson has to say today.

Side_BubbleStory_320Shopkeeper1_23247400: I'd definitely stick out like a sore thumb there...
Ehn-ne-ne! (Don't steal my job as The Fuzzy Wrench's model!)
Even if I wanted to, I couldn't!
I want to help out in the kitchen at Boom Scones!
Isn't that... a little too difficult?
Come on, say it with me...
Welcome to... I can't get the words out...
We're very sorry! Boom Scones is closed for the time being!
Side_BubbleStory_320Shopkeeper2_23248400: Ehn-ne! (It's the least I could do!)
Ehn-ne... (Things just turned out this way...)
Ehn-ne-nuh... (Ugh, this is all my fault...)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_12: Ehn-ne-ne ehn-ne? (This Terminal Device is yours, right? We wanted to ask you a favor. There's something really important to us inside. Could we take a look?)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_13: Ehn-ne-ne, ehn-ne... (I'll pay for it! Even if it means spending all my savings...)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_14: Hold on, you're saying there's something inside the Terminal Device?
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_15: I bought it because Tangerine loves sleeping on it. I guess it's because it still smells like fish after floating around in the sea for so long.
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_16: I was going to get her a proper cat tree, but she didn't like it. She only seems to like this thing...
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_17: Cats really are such weird creatures.
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_18: Cats really are such willful creatures.
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_19: Ehn-ne? Ehn-ne ehn-ne. (A cat tree? You're using the Terminal Device as a cat tree? No... that's not right.)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_20: That merchant told me there was "a secret hidden inside." I thought he was just trying to fool me. What's in there?
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_21: Ehn-ne-ne ehn-ne, ehn-ne? (It's a missing page from a picture book called The Adventures of the Bangboo Prince! If we can unlock the device and get it out, could you give it to us?)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_22: Sure! I'm curious to see what's inside too. You don't need to pay me!
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453012_23: (Can Kabka really talk to cats? Belle would totally want to learn that.)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_01: Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne-ehn... (Thank goodness! We finally found the missing page! I almost had to sell everything I own...)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_02: No way, an actual torn page from the picture book! What's on it?
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_03: Ehn-ne-ne ehn-ehn-ne... (Let me take a look! Hmm, this seems to be from the earlier part of the story. After escaping from the kingdom, the Bangboo Prince sets out on a journey, but his companions keep their distance because of who he is...)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_04: Is this the only page? What's the rest of the story?
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_05: Ehn-ne, ehn-ne! (We're not sure yet! We're searching for the missing pages of the picture book, and we've already found a whole bunch!)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_06: Ehn-ne-ne, ehn-ne. (Once we've collected all the missing pages, I'm going to turn The Adventures of the Bangboo Prince into a complete script! I want to bring those forgotten stories back into the spotlight!)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_08: Looks like Tangerine wants to see your play too!
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_09: Ehn-ne-ne, ehn-ne! (I wonder if cats are allowed in the theater... I'll go ask the person in charge!)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_10: Ehn-ne-ne ehn-ne! (If they let you in, Tangerine, do you want a front-row seat? I'll save you a spot!)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_15: Ehn-ne ehn-ne, ne-ehn-ne! (We're getting closer and closer to bringing the whole thing to life! Thanks, everyone!)
Side_Chat_320SecretRegion_232453013_16: Ehn-ne-ne, ehn-ne! (I wonder if I can work a little cameo for a cat into the script... I'll have to think about it!)
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_01: Wuh-ne-ne! Wuh-ne? Wuh-ne-ne! (Welcome home! Are you tired? Get some good rest. You've got school tomorrow!)
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_02: Thanks for asking. I'm gonna get some rest now.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_04: Wuh-ne-ne! Wuh-ne! ({F#He}{M#She} just left. Said something about going to the CCD... Oh, right! Breakfast is ready. Better eat while it's hot!)
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_06:
You've barely sat down to enjoy breakfast when panicked shouting and frantic pounding on the door suddenly break the silence—
"Belle! Wise! You home?"
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_07: Norma? Why is she here at this hour? Better go let her in first...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_09: This happened so suddenly, so I'll keep it short. Do you want to go to school?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_11: Maybe I should explain a little more...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_12: Hmm, where should I start... Belle, you're at Roscaelifer as a "special-admission transfer student" from Aurelia Academy, right?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_13: Sure, that's just your official status on paper, and you don't have to attend classes. But there are a few important classes at Aurelia Academy where it'd be good for even a "special-admission transfer student" like you to show up...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_15: Yes! Upperclassmen at Aurelia Academy have to complete their <color=#FFAF2C>practicum</color> before they can graduate!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_16: The practicum is basically a chance for students to go out and try different jobs in different places. What do you think? Interested?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_17: I'll also get to learn more about Roscaelifer...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_18: Exactly! That's why Veli asked me to see if you'd like to join the practicum. The school rarely sets aside a whole day for practicum activities!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_20: Today! The students are already gathered at the school!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_23: Ah, my bad... I've been tied up the past few days and totally forgot to tell you! It's fine if you go by yourself!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_24: If you don't come, Veli might... I mean, I'd be worried you won't be able to fit in at Roscaelifer!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_25: Fine, I'll head over right away...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_26: Yay! Enjoy your campus life to the fullest!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_27: Hmm, where should I start... Wise, you're at Roscaelifer as a "special-admission transfer student" from Aurelia Academy, right?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_30:
You get a good night's rest in the bedroom...
When you step out the next morning, {F#Wise}{M#Belle} seems to have already gone out... Oh well, breakfast first!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper1_232473001_31: A new day begins with a greeting for Bonnie—somehow, this kind of life has become familiar.

Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_01:
From a distance, you spot the Bangboo you've been looking for... For some reason, you feel a strange mix of emotions.
But just as you're about to approach and speak to him, you notice one of his feet hanging over the edge of the platform, as if he's about to throw himself into that endless abyss—
Before he can take the plunge, you rush over and grab him.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_02: Zeppelin... What are you doing here...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_03: You even came all the way here after me... But please, just... let me go.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_05: I... when I see you, I just can't bear to let this end. Please, let me go, Zeppelin...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_07: Y-You don't know anything! I haven't even told you about the things I've done wrong... Once you know everything, you'll hate me even more, Zeppelin.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_09: I've been lying to you all this time! I... I never actually traveled the world. I'm just a wretched thief, shamefully... shamefully scraping by on the money you gave me.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_10: My name isn't even Curitt... That name belonged to another Bangboo. I stole his identity and your sponsorship... Th-This was all just... "identity theft."
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_11: The stories I told you about traveling the world... they were all things I saw in movies or overheard from other people. Not one of them... not one of them was my own story.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_12:
Writing to you, Zeppelin, made me so happy.
But the happier I got, the more I remembered that the one talking to you was a fake version of me.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_13: The real me can't even leave the sewers... I'm just a freak that everyone throws rocks at...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_15: At least... you have me, right?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_16: But you're the only one who believes in me, Zeppelin. Everyone else... everyone else thinks I'm a bad guy.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_17: I wanted to stop... to stop lying to you, and try to become a good Bangboo, someone who could be useful... Then, someday, I'd meet you again under a new identity—not as Curitt, the name I stole, but as myself.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_18: But... so much has happened today... I-I understand now. As long as I'm still like this, as long as I scare people... everyone will think I'm doing something wrong. They'll misunderstand me... all of them...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_19: Doing good doesn't matter. Looking like this means I'll always be a bad guy. I'm a fake... I can't be a good Bangboo...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_22: You tell the black Bangboo standing before you everything Zeppelin asked you to do.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_24: W-What does that mean? Zeppelin's a fake too...?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_25: But if you're not Zeppelin, how could you believe me, help that little girl... and even believe the wanted posters were fake...?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_26: Actually... I'm not the only one...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_27: Griff and Prophetboo believe in you too.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_29: What...? Someone else believes in me... other than Zeppelin...?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_30: All the good things you've done...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_31: Don't mean any less because of how you look.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_32: I... I don't even know what to say after hearing all this...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_33: They say in the movies that talking things out can clear up misunderstandings... But no one would listen to me, so I stopped trying to explain.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_34: Being misunderstood made me so sad... so, so sad. But now I know some people still believe in me, even when they don't understand me...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_35: Don't you want to meet the real Zeppelin?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_37: I want to! Even if I'm a fake... maybe the real Zeppelin will see me for who I really am... just like you do.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_38: But... I can't meet Zeppelin looking like this...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483006_41:
You contact Zeppelin and tell her you've found the Bangboo she's been looking for...
Then, together with Slenderboo dressed in a Mr. Roar costume, you arrive at the entrance to The Fuzzy Wrench.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_03: Zeppelin... actually, I'm... I'm Curitt. No... I'm not Curitt...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_05: Mm-hmm, I know. You're the little guy I've been writing to, right?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_06: No... I've been lying to you all this time, Zeppelin... I've told you so many lies.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_07: The mailbox was fake... The name was fake... I stole the money meant for another Bangboo. I lied to you...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_08: To your surprise... a faint smile appears on Zeppelin's face.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_10: There wasn't even a postmark on the letters. And using an abandoned mailbox to send them... clever, I'll give you that. But I'm a local shop owner. How could I not know which mailboxes around here are still in use?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_12: As for that so-called "funding agreement," impersonating Curitt was pointless anyway. I'd already signed a new one with the real Curitt!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_13: Wh-What...? Then... then why did you give me money, Zeppelin?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_14: At first, I was just curious what kind of Bangboo would come up with such a clumsy scam...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_15: But over time, I realized you really were going through a tough time, so I kept up the "investment."
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_16: Maybe I was moved by all those "stories" of yours. Some of them were obviously made up, but the way you wrote them was so captivating. Even if they never happened...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_18: But, Zeppelin, you don't understand! I've done so many bad things. I'm actually scary. I look like a freak... I-I'm an outcast no one could ever accept. If you saw me, you'd run away, too.
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_19: I'm... that thing from the urban legend...
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_20: The... "slender shadow" that supposedly comes out at night to snatch children?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_22: You! You've still got a long way to go if you think you can hide something from me!
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_25: You must have been through so much... things that hurt you deeply, I'm sure. But... please don't let that sadness make you cut me out of your life, okay?
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_27: I want to hear more... so many more stories. Stories about the real you, about all the sadness you've been through... But before that—
Side_Chat_320Shopkeeper2_232483007_28:
First, let me give you the deluxe treatment!
You've been wandering around for so long. I'm sure you've got plenty of worn-out parts that could use some repairs~

Side_Chat_ZenkovS1_231013092_05: Ehn-ne! (The moment you touched that fissure, a powerful wave of Ether energy burst toward you. 06 and I were both thrown back. When we got back, you were already lying there unconscious...)

ZKItem_4350520_Desc:

{AWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>, greatly increasing its DMG Multiplier and Anomaly Buildup.} {NOAWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>}. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKItem_4350521_Desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Ellen's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

When Ellen uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>leaves Icy Mist on the ground</color>, dealing continuous <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> for 15s. These effects persist for 5s after leaving <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>. When Ellen hits an enemy inside <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> deals one additional instance of DMG.
ZKItem_4350522_Desc:
This Blueprint can be used to unlock Yanagi's exclusive Tactical Prism crafting at the Smart Workshop. It can be purchased from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.
Item Effect: When <color=#FFFFFF>Etheric Phantom</color> deals DMG to enemies, Tsukishiro Yanagi's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> for 60s; repeated triggers reset the duration.
Tsukishiro Yanagi can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state when she enters combat or when any squad member triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect; repeated triggers reset the duration; while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state, Tsukishiro Yanagi's <color=#2BAD00>Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG increase by 60%</color>.
ZKItem_4350523_Desc:
This Blueprint can be used to unlock Claret's exclusive Tactical Prism crafting at the Smart Workshop. It can be purchased from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.
Item Effect: After using Powerful Slash on an enemy, restores 10% HP and increases DEF by 20% for 30s.
Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon triggering Perfect Dodge, increases <color=#2BAD00>Laceration DMG by 35%</color> for 60s. If triggered while in the Crimson Inscription state, extends the duration of Crimson Inscription by 5s. This effect can trigger no more than once every 10s during the extended duration. When a <color=#FFFFFF>Counter Assist</color> attack hits an enemy, enters Vital View for 4s.
ZKItem_4350524_Desc:
This Blueprint can be used to unlock Roxy's exclusive Tactical Prism crafting at the Smart Workshop. It can be purchased from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.
Item Effect: When the Evacuation Countdown has less than 15/5/1 minutes remaining, Roxy's Impact increases by 20%/50%/100%, respectively.
When holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color>, each second of holding increases the skill's <color=#2BAD00>DMG and Daze by 10%/6%</color>, up to a maximum increase of 30%/18%. When the skill hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> for 30s.
ZKItem_4350525_Desc:
This Blueprint can be used to unlock Zhao's exclusive Tactical Prism crafting at the Smart Workshop. It can be purchased from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.
Item Effect: When there are 2 or 1 surviving Agents in the squad, extraction time is reduced by 30%/60%.

ZKItem_4350526_Desc:
This Blueprint can be used to unlock Banyue's exclusive Tactical Prism crafting at the Smart Workshop. It can be purchased from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.
Item Effect: When using Etheric Phantom: Sanguine Sweeper, all squad members immediately recover 10% of their lost Max HP, while Banyue recovers HP equal to 10% of his Max HP.
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, after Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. ZKItem_4350527_Desc:

When a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Coil</color> to attack the target. This effect can trigger no more than once every 1s.
ZKItem_4350528_Desc:
This Blueprint can be used to unlock Starlight Billy's exclusive Tactical Prism crafting at the Smart Workshop. It can be purchased from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

When successfully performing a Block during <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, gain 1 Charge stack, up to 1 stack, which <color=#2BAD00>increases the DMG</color> of the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color> <color=#2BAD00>by 100%</color>.
ZKItem_4360047_Desc: A transformation device featured in "Starlight Knight." It symbolizes the miraculous power brought upon by shooting stars. "Breaking the limits of what's possible, I arrive in the chariot of stars. Lower the hand that blocks out their brilliance and face your undoing!"
ZKItem_4360048_Desc: Looks like an accessory belonging to a member of some idol group. Probably dropped here while making a run from the "Divine Maze".
ZKItem_4360049_Desc: Looks like it's a prized accessory belonging to some rising star in New Eridu. Safe to say the owner and their bodyguard are scrambling to get it back.
ZKItem_4360050_Desc: Looks like a veil belonging to some mysterious lady. Lean in close, and you might just hear her gentle whisper still lingering in your ear.
ZKItem_4360051_Desc: Seems to be the anklet of a certain rabbit Thiren. The delicate bell will ring as the wearer runs.
ZKItem_4360052_Desc: A stamp issued during the old capital era to commemorate the achievements of the original seven Void Hunters who fought against the Hollows. After all these years, Lieutenant Colonel Dan's stamp seems to have gathered a little dust.
ZKItem_4360053_Desc: A stamp issued during the old capital era to commemorate the achievements of the original seven Void Hunters who fought against the Hollows. For unknown reasons, Colonel Vike's stamp is stained with blood.
ZKItem_4360054_Desc: A transformation device featured in "Starlight Knight." It symbolizes an eternal white star that remains unchanged throughout the ages. "Flawless and faultless, shapeless and endless. I will never recede. I'm unwavering just like eternity."
ZKItem_4360055_Desc: A transformation device featured in "Starlight Knight." It symbolizes an apocalyptic star that sets the galaxy ablaze. "The whole dimension may distort, and the galaxy may shake, but even if my whole body is torn apart, I will never lose sight of evil. Together, we'll witness the raging star's end!"
ZKItem_4360056_Desc: A transformation device featured in "Starlight Knight," embodying the power of a black hole that devours all. "The dawn sky, the shining oath? All shall be swallowed by the black hole!"
ZKItem_4360057_Desc: The Bangboo instant noodle figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO—a classic flavor beloved by everyone in Ridu.
ZKItem_4360058_Desc: A Bangboo instant noodle figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Shrimp and fish cake, delicious enough to make you shout!
ZKItem_4360059_Desc: A Bangboo instant noodle figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. This particular flavor, however, never quite caught on with the people of Waifei Peninsula. Even when a Hollow disaster strikes and everyone's scrambling to stock up on supplies, this one gets left on the shelf.
ZKItem_4360060_Desc: A Bangboo instant noodle figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Sour, scrappy, and oh-so-adorable!
ZKItem_4360061_Desc: A gem cut and polished by LionHeart. Its vibrant green luster calls to mind a corner of a lush green garden. Often seen as a symbol of vitality.
ZKItem_4360062_Desc: A gemstone cut and polished by LionHeart. Its honey-colored crystal seems to be brimming with lucky energy. Often seen as a symbol of warmth and harvest.
ZKItem_4360063_Desc: A gemstone cut and polished by LionHeart. Its fiery red hue burns bright and bold. Often seen as a symbol of love or power.
ZKItem_4360064_Desc: A gemstone cut and polished by "LionHeart." Its clear blue hue reflects a tranquil state of mind. Often seen as a symbol of wisdom.
ZKItem_4360065_Desc: Sealed files from TOPS, containing research findings on the Papago Hollow. The way through the labyrinth might just be found within.
ZKItem_4360066_Desc: Sealed files from TOPS, containing research findings on the Darkwater Research Center. Maybe there's something in here about how to become a super investigator?
ZKItem_4360067_Desc: Sealed files from TOPS, containing research findings on Ethereal mechanical technology. I'm not turning into an Ethereal, Proxy!
ZKItem_4360068_Desc: Sealed files from the TOPS research institute. Every record inside has been encrypted, making them difficult to crack. Whatever's in here must be seriously dangerous.
ZKItem_Bottom_Source_Season: Purchased from <color=#D9A600>Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale</color>.
ZKItem_Desc_43110221: Upon using, summon Boojee to take selected supplies (not including Gear, Polychromes, or Z-Merits) back to the research station. Can only be used once per investigation, <color=#FFAF2C>but as long as you put the items into Boojee's bag, his loyalty to Gear Coins will ensure that his mission to bring them back is completed</color>.
ZKItem_Desc_43342071: When used, summons a phantom of the <color=#FFAF2C>Sanguine Sweeper</color>, restoring <color=#2BAD00>80</color>/<color=#2BAD00>80</color>/<color=#2BAD00>80</color> Energy/Adrenaline/Sharpness for all Agents.
ZKItem_Desc_BP_Source_Rare: Purchased from <color=#D9A600>Permanent Store - Blueprint Direct Sale</color>.

When Sunna's Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>deal 80% more DMG</color> with their Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, and EX Special Attack.
ZKRelic_13701410_des:
Cissia's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When using Etheric Phantom to enter Stealth, Stealth duration is extended by 3s.
After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Viper Strike</color> effect: When any Non-<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> attack hits an enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>triggers a free special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color></color> that cannot inflict Daze. This effect can be triggered once every 1s and lasts for 6s.
ZKRelic_13701510_des:
Nangong Yu's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Nangong Yu's precise charging deals 20% more Daze. If your Inventory contains a Valuable, Etheric Phantom: Scorched Horizon increases the Stun DMG Multiplier of enemies it hits by 30%.
When Nangong Yu triggers Precise Charging, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>recover 4 Energy</color>. Whenever any squad member uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, all squad members recover 120 Decibels.
ZKRelic_13701610_des:
Promeia's exclusive Tactical Prism.
While Cacophony Soundscape is active, Promeia's DMG increases by 15%.
When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>restores 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, and when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Abloom DMG increases by 6%</color>, stacking up to 10 times, lasting 60s.
ZKRelic_13701710_des:
Pyrois's exclusive Tactical Prism.
The map will mark the locations of some unopened Electronic Strongboxes.
Upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Pyrois <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 Energy and 20 Solar Prominence</color>.
ZKRelic_13701810_des:
Norma's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Etheric Phantom: Scorpse deals 50% more DMG.
When another squad member uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Norma <color=#2BAD00>immediately gains 100% Preheated Chamber</color>. This effect can trigger once every 40s.
When any Agent uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, that Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate increases by 25%</color> for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKRelic_13701910_des:
Velina's exclusive Tactical Prism.
Using Etheric Phantom: Unfathomable deals additional Abloom DMG.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is on the field, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate increases by 40% and Decibel Generation Rate by 30%</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 3s longer</color>.
ZKRelic_13702210_des:
Tsukishiro Yanagi's exclusive Tactical Prism.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Etheric Phantom</color> deals DMG to enemies, Tsukishiro Yanagi's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> for 60s; repeated triggers reset the duration.
Tsukishiro Yanagi can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state when she enters combat or when any squad member triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect; repeated triggers reset the duration; while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Shinrabanshou</color> state, Tsukishiro Yanagi's <color=#2BAD00>Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG increase by 60%</color>.
ZKRelic_13702310_des: Claret's exclusive Tactical Prism. After using Powerful Slash on an enemy, restores 10% HP and increases DEF by 20% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon triggering Perfect Dodge, increases <color=#2BAD00>Laceration DMG by 35%</color> for 60s. If triggered while in the Crimson Inscription state, extends the duration of Crimson Inscription by 5s. This effect can trigger no more than once every 10s during the extended duration. When a <color=#FFFFFF>Counter Assist</color> attack hits an enemy, enters Vital View for 4s.
ZKRelic_13702410_des: Roxy's exclusive Tactical Prism. When the Evacuation Countdown has less than 15/5/1 minutes remaining, Roxy's Impact increases by 20%/50%/100%, respectively. When holding <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill</color>, each second of holding increases the skill's <color=#2BAD00>DMG and Daze by 10%/6%</color>, up to a maximum increase of 30%/18%. When the skill hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> for 30s.
ZKRelic_13702510_des: Zhao's exclusive Tactical Prism. When there are 2 or 1 surviving Agents in the squad, extraction time is reduced by 30%/60%. When Zhao activates Ether Veil, she recovers 30 Frostbite Points and <color=#2BAD00>increases ATK by 25%</color> for all squad members, lasting 50s.
ZKRelic_13702610_des: Banyue's exclusive Tactical Prism. When using Etheric Phantom: Sanguine Sweeper, all squad members immediately recover 10% of their lost Max HP, while Banyue recovers HP equal to 10% of his Max HP. When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, after Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. Banyue's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>60% increased Sheer DMG</color>.
ZKRelic_13702710_des: Yidhari's exclusive Tactical Prism. When the squad is affected by Corruption, the Max HP reduction is reduced to 10%. After Yidhari consumes Adrenaline to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she gains 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Coil</color>. When a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Coil</color> to attack the target. This effect can trigger no more than once every 1s.
ZKRelic_13702810_des: Starlight Billy's exclusive Tactical Prism. For each red Collectible in the Inventory or Safe, DMG taken from Boss and The Hound - Ulidim is reduced by 4%, up to 5 stacks max. When successfully performing a Block during <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, gain 1 Charge stack, up to 1 stack, which <color=#2BAD00>increases the DMG</color> of the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color> <color=#2BAD00>by 100%</color>.
